post.description: Publishes a message to all MQTT clients whose subscriptions match the topic, through the same pipeline as a PUBLISH received from a client: total throughput quota, retained-message store, publish queue and delivery. The publisher client id is 'tbmq_rest_api'. A 2xx response means the broker queue accepted the message, not that any client received it. The payload is a Base64 string by default; set 'payloadEncoding' to TEXT for a UTF-8 string or to JSON to publish any JSON value as its compact JSON text.

200.description: Accepted by the queue; at least one subscription matched the topic.

202.description: Accepted by the queue; no subscription matched the topic (reason code 16). A retained message is still stored.

400.description: Invalid topic, payload, encoding or MQTT property.

411.description: The request has no Content-Length header (chunked bodies are not accepted).

413.description: Request body exceeds the limit derived from 'server.rest_publish.max_payload_size'.

429.description: Refused by the total incoming throughput quota.

503.description: The broker queue rejected the message or did not acknowledge it in time. On a timeout the message may still have been published, so retries can produce duplicates.

RestPublishProperties.description: MQTT 5 PUBLISH properties. Every field is optional.

payloadFormatIndicator.description: Payload Format Indicator: 0 - unspecified bytes, 1 - UTF-8 encoded character data.

responseTopic.description: Response Topic for request/response messaging. Must be a valid topic name (no wildcards).

RestPublishRequest.description: MQTT message to publish through the broker.

topic.description: Topic name to publish to. Wildcards are not allowed.

payload.description: Message payload, in the form declared by 'payloadEncoding'. An empty payload with 'retain' set clears the retained message.

payloadEncoding.description: Form of the 'payload' field: BASE64 (default) - a Base64 string of the raw message bytes; TEXT - a string, published as its UTF-8 bytes; JSON - any JSON value (object, array, string, number, boolean), published as its compact JSON text.

retain.description: Whether the message should be stored as the retained message for the topic.

RestPublishResponse.description: Outcome of a REST publish. The message was accepted by the broker; this does not confirm delivery to any client.

reasonCode.description: MQTT PUBACK reason code: 0 - success, 16 - no matching subscribers (the message was still processed, e.g. stored as retained).

message.description: Human-readable description of the reason code.

minMessagesProcessed.description: The minimum number of successfully processed messages

maxMessagesProcessed.description: The maximum number of successfully processed messages

minErrorsOccurred.description: The minimum number of errors occurred during messages processing

maxErrorsOccurred.description: The maximum number of errors occurred during messages processing
